changes.summary: Imported the M3 Wave 4 collection/selection/navigation-dependent primitive batch (combobox, calendar, date_picker) for task 4.5, plus separator (a Wave 2 item, ported now only because it is a hard dependency of the sidebar registry composition -- the rest of Wave 2 remains unmigrated, see tasks.md/m3-migration-queue.md follow-up note). combobox needed zero adaptation beyond a Rust-2024 return-position-impl-Trait lifetime-capture fix (`+ use<>` on ComboboxContext::predicate/predicate_for, required because 2024 now captures the elided `&self` lifetime by default, conflicting with the following `&mut self.selectable` calls); it reuses the collection/selectable/listbox infrastructure already imported for select verbatim. calendar and date_picker (2806 and 1445 lines) compiled essentially unmodified after two fixes: (1) this crate's own private `mod time` (target-aware sleep support) shadows the external `time` crate name inside lib.rs specifically (sibling modules like calendar.rs are unaffected since they never import `crate::time`), fixed by qualifying the new `LocalDateExt` impl as `::time::...`; (2) upstream's internal doctest/test code referenced its own crate as `dioxus_primitives`, renamed to `adico_primitives`. Added `time =0.3.44` (`std`, `macros`, `parsing`, `local-offset` features; `web` feature now also enables `time/wasm-bindgen`, needed for `local-offset` under wasm), `num-integer =0.1.46` (date_picker only), and `dioxus-ssr =0.7.0` as a dev-dependency (matches upstream, only used by calendar/date_picker's own internal SSR-rendering unit tests). No document::eval, dioxus-attributes, or merge_attributes usage in any of these four files -- unlike Wave 3, no target-gating or attribute-spread adaptation was needed. Verified for native (SSR-safe default, 23 unit tests + 40 doctests all passing), `--features web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`, and `--features desktop`.

Real-browser testing (a live `dx serve` fixture plus Playwright) surfaced that `CalendarMonthTitle`/`CalendarGrid` (and other view-scoped calendar subcomponents) read a `CalendarViewContext` provided only by `CalendarView`, which is not optional despite its own doc comment describing it as something you 'render one of... for each month you want visible' -- omitting it is a `use_context` panic (a wasm `unreachable` trap) at first render, not a compile error. Eleven of this file's own doc examples (inherited verbatim from upstream, including the primary `Calendar` example) omitted this wrapper; since doctests in this crate are compiled but never executed, the gap was never caught until an actual browser mounted the component. Fixed all eleven affected doc examples in calendar.rs to nest their `CalendarHeader`/`CalendarGrid` content inside `CalendarView` and added an explicit warning to CalendarView's own doc comment. This is upstream's own latent bug, not introduced by adaptation; not filed upstream since this fork tracks a pinned historical revision rather than a live branch.

Re-authored packages/adico-primitives/src/combobox/{mod,context}.rs and combobox/components/{mod,combobox,input,list,empty,option}.rs (8 files) as a single packages/adico-primitives/src/combobox.rs, per openspec/changes/reauthor-primitives-from-independent-spec task 2.2 (build-adico-component-ecosystem task 7.8d), mirroring select.rs's own task 2.1 rewrite (see provenance/records/adico-primitives-dialog-select.json) since the same gap existed here: ComboboxList's listbox previously rendered inline in normal document flow with no anchored positioning or layer/dismiss participation, and Escape was hand-rolled on ComboboxInput's own onkeydown with no layer-stack awareness. Wired onto use_escape_key (root, via a new ComboboxContext.root_id) and use_outside_dismiss (list, via use_layer_member, bound to that same root_id) plus positioner::Positioner as the listbox's own root element, anchored to ComboboxInput via a new ComboboxContext.input_id that ComboboxInput publishes from its own (unchanged) use_id_or-resolved id through a use_effect, preserving its pre-existing caller-id-override support unlike select's trigger (which had none to preserve). Extended positioner.rs (not itself forked) with one further prop this migration needed beyond select's on_mounted/on_keydown/on_blur: on_pointer_down, since ComboboxList's listbox already prevented pointer-down default to keep DOM focus in the input (combobox's ARIA model never moves focus into options, unlike select's) and Positioner's attributes-extends mechanism does not cover event listeners on a component call. Filtering/selection/roving-focus logic (ComboboxContext's predicate/visibility methods) carried over unchanged, already covered by selectable.rs's/collection.rs's own tests. Added 6 tests in the new packages/adico-primitives/tests/test_combobox.rs covering closed/open/disabled render state, the input's pre-existing id, and the listbox's aria-multiselectable/position:fixed wiring; per-option state (selection, filter-visibility, the empty state) could not be asserted here since ComboboxOption's own visibility read depends on the same use_effect-driven option-registration hook select.rs's tests already found untestable under a bare rebuild_in_place() -- two draft assertions along those lines were written, found to pass vacuously (an empty-matching-everything query and a zzz-matching-nothing query produced identical, entirely-optionless output), and removed rather than kept as misleading coverage. No consumer fixture or Playwright spec exists for combobox at all (unlike select, which at least had tests/installation/select-consumer and select.spec.ts already) -- registry/ui/combobox.rs's facade was never previously exercised through a real installed consumer in a live browser, and this task did not create one (that is task 2.4's scope). Verified via cargo test -p adico-primitives (all passing, including the pre-existing suite) and cargo run -p adico-xtask -- registry validate; live-browser/Playwright verification for combobox remains an open gap, compounded by the same pre-existing positioner.rs document::eval anchor-measurement bug select.rs's task 2.1 entry documents. Removed the 8 files' SPDX fork headers and dropped them from this record's originalPaths/localPaths; calendar.rs, date_picker.rs, and separator.rs remain tracked.

notices: Upstream is dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0; its LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE texts are retained in third_party/dioxus-components/.
Each imported source unit identifies its immutable upstream revision and original path.

sidebar (also part of M3 Wave 4) has no upstream primitives/src file at all -- it ships upstream only as a styled preview component under preview/src/components/sidebar/, using CSS modules and a document::eval-based mobile-viewport hook of the same long-lived/repeatedly-firing kind already found non-functional in this runtime during Wave 3. It is therefore implemented directly as a registry:ui composition (registry/ui/sidebar.rs) rather than an adico-primitives module, and is not covered by this provenance record; see docs/adico/m3-wave4-migration.md for the adaptation.
